caption:
Figure 2: Overview of the proposed approach. Given a single RGB image, our model detects object centers as key-points in a heatmap Y .
The network directly predicts shape exemplars z and 9-DoF bounding boxes jointly for all objects in the scene. The collision loss L
coll
favors non-intersecting reconstructions. Our method predicts lightweight, realistic and physically plausible reconstructions in a single pass.
